content:
Amazon's Black Friday sale is now live for November 19 and shoppers can browse a ton of new discounts starting today. We're still a full week away from Thanksgiving and actual Black Friday, but if you're looking to save some money on some cool stuff right now, you can check out Amazon's official Black Friday deals hub.

Today is also GTA 6 launch day, though, so many of you might be wondering if you actually need to do your shopping right now or if it can take a back seat to gaming. While Amazon will definitely have some discounts on day one that sell out quickly, the bulk of the retailer's best deals are likely yet to come. Right now only Amazon and Best Buy have fully kicked off their Black Friday sales, which means the competition for your hard-earned dollars is only just getting started. Both Target and Nintendo have stated that their official sales will go live on Sunday, November 22 this year and Walmart will follow just a day later. So If you want to shop at peak Black Friday time, waiting for next week should be fine.

What to Buy Now

The IGN Deals team will be doing our best to highlight the discounts that do deserve your immediate attention. Amazon has already had some good Apple deals running this week and most of the 4K Blu-ray deals appear to be live, so we recommend checking both of those sales out. PlayStation launched its sale on physical games and controllers as well. We're also seeing some surprisingly good deals on retired LEGO sets today, which are sure to go out of stock before the weekend. So if you see a LEGO deal you like today, it's definitely worth picking it up while you still can.

What to Expect From the Rest of Amazon Black Friday

Amazon's Black Friday sale will run from now until Cyber Monday with new deal drops every day. It's hard to predict exactly when new discounts will arrive on Amazon in the lead-up to Black Friday this year, but we can make a pretty educated guess based on other upcoming sale dates.

Discounts on Nintendo Switch 2 Bundles and Games on Sunday

Nintendo announced its Black Friday plans earlier this month and we now know that the bulk of the Switch 2 deals aren't going to start until November 22. Those deals will include $50 off the Nintendo Switch 2 + Mario Kart World Bundle as well as $20 discounts on first-party titles like Donkey Kong Bananza.

Buy 2, Get 1 Free Books and Music This Weekend

Amazon already dropped a buy 2, get 1 free sale on books earlier this month but you can expect another round this weekend. That's because Target has indicated in its Black Friday ad that it will be having its own sale on books and music. Amazon pretty much always price matches these types of promotions, so it's pretty much a given that it will happen again.

New LEGO Deals on Actual Black Friday

Amazon already has some great LEGO deals going on, but some of the best ones are yet to come. We know this because LEGO's official Black Friday sale doesn't actually start unitl Black Friday proper. Amazon and other major retailers always save some of their best LEGO deals for the same day and they usually go out of stock before Cyber Monday.
